messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "doses may be increased in daily increments of up to 75 mg orally at intervals of no less than 4 days"
set: ["doses may be increased in daily increments of up to 75 mg orally at intervals of no less than 4 days", "75 mg orally", "one to two additional doses given at intervals of 4 to 6 hours", "daily dose may be raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals until an optimal response is obtained", "dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily", "daily dose may be raised in 10 mg increments at weekly intervals until an optimal response is obtained", "dose should be increased to 75 mg/day", "may be kept at room temperature for up to 21 days", "50 mg orally per day every 3 to 4 days", "daily dosage of immediate-release formulations may be divided into three doses per day", "may be kept at room temperature up to 86°F (30°C)", "taken with no more than 4 ounces of plain water only", "take with no more than 4 ounces of plain water only", "healthcare providers should consider initial extended release doses of 37.5 mg orally once a day for 4 to 7 days", "dose may be gradually increased", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on current dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
